rules: Uptrend: the pole top is a higher high (above the previous swing high, zigzag 6%) and the flag low a higher low (above the previous swing low); 21-day average rising, 200-day average rising. Pole: >= 15% rise in <= 15 sessions from the swing low to the highest high. Pause (3-25 sessions): Flag = highs and lows drifting down, Pennant = highs falling and lows rising, Rectangle = flat box;  falling or flat highs, pullback <= half the pole and <= 12%, no close above the pole top, close above the 200-day average. Early = the pole started within 4% of the 200-day average (fresh uptrend); established = 50 > 200-day average, both rising. Trigger = the flag's top line; stop = flag low; target = trigger + pole.
backtest: Tested 14 Nov 2026 (769 NSE stocks 2015-26): bull flags in uptrends +3.3% vs the market over 60 days; as a full system 22.2%/yr but -40.9% worst fall (ATH breakout 19.8%, -37%), and it flips sign in several years. Early vs established lanes not tested yet - watch only.
